---
name: Propose a new agent
about: Suggest a new specialist role for the team
title: "[agent] "
labels: new-agent
---

**Role**
What does this agent do? (one sharp sentence)

**Command & persona**
Proposed `/command` (+ optional persona alias/name).

**Is it a role or a stack?**
Distinct **role** (→ new agent) or a technology **variant** of an existing role (→ a `references/<stack>.md` under that role)? See `claude/skills/disambiguation.md`.

**Disambiguation**
Which existing agent is it most likely to be confused with, and how is it different?

**Gate involvement (if any)**
Does it own or contribute to a workflow gate?

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` → "Add a new agent in ~5 minutes".
